description: Use this when you need proof of what an agent or shop page declared on a date. Pass its `url` (optional `since`, `until`). Returns an extract of GAIP's record as kept: entries with chain positions, hashes, daily anchors and a signature. Free preview. Free, read-only, no account; inputs must be public and non-personal.

limit.description: Optional: most entries to return, newest kept (default 50).

since.description: Optional: start of the range (YYYY-MM-DD or RFC 3339).

until.description: Optional: end of the range (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, or RFC 3339).

url.description: The A2A agent card, MCP endpoint or shop product page URL, exactly as recorded.

name: gaip_record_extract
title: Extract of GAIP's record about a URL
